stories.title: Four takeaways from Mark Zuckerberg’s massive AI manifesto
stories.simple_summary: Mark Zuckerberg wrote a very long essay about how he thinks artificial intelligence will change the future and how people should live alongside it.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry watchers — Zuckerberg's personal vision doesn't directly affect what you use today.

stories.title: Meta launches new Muse Glimmer AI model to democratize artificial intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Meta created a new AI tool they're making available to more people so they can use artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly of interest to tech companies and engineers — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Bose CEO Lila Snyder on the fight for high-quality audio
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Bose, the speaker company, talked about how her company focuses on making great sound quality.
stories.why_it_matters: This isn't really about AI — it's just a conversation about a speaker company's work, so it doesn't affect you unless you buy Bose products.

stories.title: Zuckerberg lays out vision to put superintelligent AI in everyone's hands
stories.simple_summary: Zuckerberg said he wants to create very powerful artificial intelligence and put it in the hands of ordinary people instead of just keeping it for big companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is Zuckerberg's future plan and mostly interests investors — it's not something that will happen immediately.

stories.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
stories.simple_summary: A company got $9 million in funding to search for new materials that could help make computer chips work better and use less energy.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and investors — nothing you need to know about unless you work in tech.

stories.title: Ford’s new AI assistant can check your fuel levels and tire pressure
stories.simple_summary: Ford created an AI assistant in their car app that can answer questions about your vehicle, like how much gas you need or if your truck can tow something.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a Ford or Lincoln, you might find this helpful for quick questions about your car instead of looking it up yourself.

stories.title: Meta Unveils ‘Open Source’ Version of Its Most Powerful A.I. Model
stories.simple_summary: Meta released its most powerful AI model in a way that many programmers can access and use freely.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly of interest to software developers and companies building new tools — it doesn't directly change your daily life.

stories.title: Chinese farmer kills 25 acres of crops after following AI-generated weed and pest control advice — farmer trusted pesticide recipe after months of successful advice
stories.simple_summary: A Chinese farmer destroyed 25 acres of crops after following pest control advice from an AI system that turned out to be wrong, even though the advice had worked before.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a real warning that you shouldn't trust AI advice for important decisions without checking with a real expert first — like asking a doctor, not just trusting an online tool.

stories.title: Opinion | A.I. Will Affect Your Social Life. Yes, Yours.
stories.simple_summary: A newspaper opinion piece argues that artificial intelligence will eventually change how people interact socially with each other.
stories.why_it_matters: This is someone's prediction about the future — interesting to think about, but it's opinion, not something happening right now.

stories.title: Tech leaders say AI means less work - their staff say they work up to 90 hours a week
stories.simple_summary: Tech company leaders say AI should mean their workers have less work to do, but the workers themselves say they're actually working 90 hours a week.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows a gap between what leaders promise AI will do and what's actually happening — a good reminder to be skeptical of big promises about technology saving you work.

stories.title: Google's AI Is Killing the Web. Now The Web Is Fighting Back
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI search tools are hurting the regular internet, so websites and internet creators are starting to fight back against it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a website or blog, this could matter to you — Google's AI might be taking your content without sending customers to you.

stories.title: Explainer: What is Unitree and why are China’s humanoid robot makers racing to list?
stories.simple_summary: A Chinese robotics company called Unitree is making humanoid robots (robots that look and move like humans) and wants to sell stock in their company.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a business story for investors — unless you work in manufacturing or robotics, it doesn't affect your daily life right now.
